records.scope: Mouse hypothalamus — pooled 14/17-day overfeeding effect (bulk RNA-seq); all 1 registered contrasts on default track hypothalamus

sourceChecks.label: Independent biological replication
sourceChecks.note: 12 baseline and 12 case animal units are supported by primary sources. Source-replicate aliases identify the documented sampling units; unpublished animal or donor IDs are not invented. All 24 exact GEO titles match the registered hypothalamic columns. The paper states single housing throughout experimental overfeeding and recovery, followed by terminal collection in separate day-14 and day-17 cohorts. Each arm contains twelve source animal profiles; day is retained in the registered batch model. The authors removed one day-14 control for poor RNA quality, while the current registered input retains all 24. This replication pass does not override that author-analysis cohort difference or certify that excluded sample quality.

records.scope: Mouse hypothalamus — chow vs HFD (brain atlas; bulk RNA-seq); all 1 registered contrasts on default track hypothalamus

sourceChecks.label: Independent biological replication
sourceChecks.note: Primary-source replication review remains unresolved. The complete author Zenodo archive resolves the misleading GSM-looking local aliases to twelve actual hypothalamic profiles. Its 57,010-gene by 185-library count body exactly matches the deposited GEO matrix, and unique author names join whole original GEO descriptions. Current aliases GSM7517823-7517828 map to hypothalamic GSM7517799-GSM7517804; GSM7517883-GSM7517888 map to GSM7517859-GSM7517864. The alias-named PFC records remain preserved as the original mistaken interpretation, not the tissue identity of the selected count columns. Actual HY metadata preserves animals 1-6 and 13-18 in cages 34-36 and 40-42, two animals per cage. Primary study 1 randomized three cages per diet; the current model has no cage adjustment. HY GSM7517859, retained as local GSM7517883, additionally has the deposited qc: fail PCA flag. Source identity is resolved, but cage-level dependency and the selected flagged profile require model/filtering review. The separately housed twenty-four-hour fasting study is excluded. Scientific input bytes, aliases, selection and model are unchanged.

records.scope: Rat rostral posterior hypothalamus — repeated noise stress; all 1 registered contrasts on default track rph

sourceChecks.label: Independent biological replication
sourceChecks.note: 6 baseline and 6 case animal units are supported by primary sources. Biological replication is supported, but this does not certify the retained libraries against the authors' sequencing-quality exclusions or imply exact author-cohort reproduction.

records.scope: Piglet hypothalamus — formula composition; all 1 registered contrasts on default track hypothalamus

sourceChecks.label: Independent biological replication
sourceChecks.note: Primary-source replication review remains unresolved. The study individually randomizes piglets after matching weight, sex and litter, then explicitly group-houses them by assigned formula in two farrowing pens during intervention. Current data cover 12 WPI and 11 ALAC terminal hypothalamic profiles from the reported three sow litters. Independent pen-level treatment replication and a full selected pig-to-pen/litter map are not established; the current model adjusts sex only. Pen and litter dependence therefore remain under review. Individual bottle feeding and biological specimen identity do not resolve formula-specific shared housing.

sourceChecks.label: Model design and input scale
sourceChecks.note: edgeR-QL matches the configured counts input. Recomputed sex + group design rank is 3/3, with 20 residual degrees of freedom. This checks identifiability and the declared route, not every biological confounder.

check.label: Reviewed source and model limitations
check.note: default track/alpha_lactalbumin_vs_wpi_formula_sex_adjusted: The selected 23 formula-fed piglets come from the stated three sow litters and share two farrowing pens during intervention. Individual bottle feeding does not remove this known shared structure.

records.scope: Mouse hypothalamus Gough Island divergence; all 1 registered tracks and 1 comparisons

sourceChecks.label: Independent biological replication
sourceChecks.note: 0/1 assessments pass this check. Primary-source replication review remains unresolved. All 20 current GSMs and whole source titles identify 28-day hypothalamus specimens, balanced five animals per sex/strain. Other tissues from these same animals and other ages are excluded. The primary paper states that all four-week island males came from one litter, island females from four litters, and mainland conditions from two to four litters; weanlings were group-housed. Source metadata does not map each selected animal to its litter/cage. The group-plus-sex model cannot separate those dependencies. A source claim treating mice as independent does not resolve the documented sibling structure.
